speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are presenting with generalized fatigue, severe pruritus, and abnormal liver function tests. To better understand the nature of your illness, have you noticed any jaundice, dark urine, or pale stools recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; your history of ulcerative colitis, sexual activity with multiple female partners, and inconsistent condom use raises concern for Hepatitis B or C, as well as potential drug-induced liver injury or biliary obstruction. Given your severe pruritus and fatigue, have you noticed any yellowing of your eyes or skin, or have you recently started any new medications for your colitis? REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (bilirubin, alkaline phosphatase, ALT, AST, GGT), Hepatitis B surface antigen, Hepatitis C antibody.
